critical_path.description: All claims must be verified before any asset can reference them. Without verification, assets cannot be built or reviewed.
Assets cannot proceed to legal review until fully developed and tagged with claim pillars and segments.
No launch post can be published without legal sign-off on all assets and final positioning statement.

risk_register.title: Claim verification fails due to missing source data
risk_register.description: A claim in the proof pillars lacks a verifiable source, leading to invalid claims or legal exposure.
risk_register.mitigation: All claims must be cross-referenced with internal benchmarks or test logs before entry into validation. Any missing data triggers discovery item.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: A claim is submitted without a source document or test run reference in the claims register.
risk_register.audit_hook: The claims verification log must include a timestamped record of each source document used.

risk_register.title: Legal review delays due to inconsistent terminology
risk_register.description: Terminology drift between assets and positioning statement leads to legal rejection.
risk_register.mitigation: All terms used in the positioning statement and assets must be defined in the glossary. Any deviation triggers a re-review.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: An asset uses a term not defined in the glossary or inconsistent with the positioning statement.
risk_register.audit_hook: The glossary is reviewed against all assets at the end of each phase.

risk_register.title: Failure to meet day-7 success metric threshold
risk_register.description: Launch fails to achieve minimum conversion rate, undermining ROI and funnel performance.
risk_register.mitigation: Day-7 and day-30 metrics are tracked in real time with automated dashboards. If thresholds not met by day 14, launch is paused and re-evaluated.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Day-7 conversion rate drops below 2% after first week of exposure.
risk_register.audit_hook: The funnel dashboard must be updated daily and shared at 9:00 AM on launch day.

risk_register.title: Asset delivery delay due to unowned workstream
risk_register.description: A workstream is not owned or assigned, leading to stalled progress.
risk_register.mitigation: All workstreams must have a named owner and clear deliverables. Unowned sections are returned immediately.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: A workstream appears in the plan without an owner or delivery date.
risk_register.audit_hook: The program manager reviews all workstreams at phase entry and exit.

decision_log.decision: All claims not in the approved claims register must carry a verification marker.
decision_log.reasoning: The brand is allergic to hype; every number must be traceable to source data or verified by internal benchmarks. This prevents unverified assertions from appearing in content.
decision_log.information_needed: Approved claims register and source documents for each proof pillar

decision_log.decision: The positioning statement must be under seventy-five words and include category, buyer, pain, differentiated claim, and reason to believe in.
decision_log.reasoning: Audience distrusts superlatives; the positioning must respect their intelligence by being precise and grounded in evidence.
decision_log.information_needed: Three proof pillars, audience segments, incumbent categories

decision_log.decision: Launch execution is blocked until all assets pass legal and references review with inline markers.
decision_log.reasoning: Legal and references review runs inline; any asset without a marker is not approved for public release.
decision_log.information_needed: Final version of each asset with inline markers [REF-001 to REF-014]
decision_log.timeframe: Day 5 of Review & Approval Cycle phase

decision_log.decision: If day-7 success metric is not met, launch is paused and re-evaluated.
decision_log.reasoning: Success metrics are defined in standard funnel vocabulary; failure to meet thresholds undermines product ROI.
decision_log.information_needed: Daily funnel performance dashboard with conversion rates

document.notes: All numbers not in the approved claims register carry verification markers. All claims are traceable to source data or test logs. The critical path is derived from hard dependencies only. Derived dates (e.g., launch day) are labeled as 'derived' and must be recomputed if any hard dependency slips by more than 2 days. Rounding occurs only in success metrics, where values are rounded to nearest whole percent. Totals and components reconcile exactly; mismatch triggers a hard error. The glossary is defined in the process discipline section and used consistently across all assets.
